title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Incorrect Permission…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially cause a denial of service. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-732 and has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.8.
